function nullIfUndefined(value) {
  return value === undefined ? null : value
}

async function generatePayload() {
  const payload = {
    countryId: nullIfUndefined(selectTaraCorespondentaTitular.value),
    countryName: nullIfUndefined(selectTaraCorespondentaTitular.selectedLabel),
    countyName: nullIfUndefined(inputContainerTitularCorespondentaJudet.value),
    locality: nullIfUndefined(inputContainerTitularCorespondentaLocalitate.value),
    streetName: nullIfUndefined(inputContainerTitularCorespondentaStrada.value),
    streetNumber: nullIfUndefined(inputContainerTitularCorespondentaNr.value),
    building: nullIfUndefined(inputContainerTitularCorespondentaBloc.value),
    buildingEntrance: nullIfUndefined(inputContainerTitularCorespondentaScara.value),
    floorNumber: nullIfUndefined(inputContainerTitularCorespondentaEtaj.value),
    apartmentNumber: nullIfUndefined(inputContainerTitularCorespondentaApartament.value),
  
    contactAddressId: nullIfUndefined(API_FilterPersonPaymentView.data?.content?.[0]?.addressId),
    postalOfficeCode: nullIfUndefined(inputContainerTitularCorespondentaOP.value),
  
    justifyingDetails: nullIfUndefined(inputContainerTitularCorespondentaCTP.value),
    justifyingDetailsCTP: nullIfUndefined(API_FilterPersonPaymentView.data?.content?.[0]?.justifyingDetailsCTP),
    justifyingDetailsDP: nullIfUndefined(API_FilterPersonPaymentView.data?.content?.[0]?.justifyingDetailsDP),
  
    personTypeId: nullIfUndefined(radioPersoanaAbilitata.value),
    authorizationStartDate: nullIfUndefined(dataStartProcura.value),
    authorizationEndDate: nullIfUndefined(dataScadentaProcura.value),
    authorizationNumber: nullIfUndefined(inputNrProcura.value),
  
    cns: nullIfUndefined(v_communication.value?.cns),
    beneficiaryCNS: nullIfUndefined(v_beneficaryCNS.value),
    pensionFileId: nullIfUndefined(v_communication.value?.pensionFileId),
    rightsCollectionId: nullIfUndefined(API_FilterPersonPaymentView.data?.content?.[0]?.rightsCollectionId),
  
    ownerQualityId: nullIfUndefined(radioCalitateTitular.value),
    postalOfficeId: nullIfUndefined(v_selectedPostalOffice.value?.id),
    agreementDate: nullIfUndefined(dataProcura.value),
  
    countyFKRo: nullIfUndefined(API_FilterPersonPaymentView.data?.content?.[0]?.countyFKRo),
    localityFK: nullIfUndefined(API_FilterPersonPaymentView.data?.content?.[0]?.localityFK),
    streetFK: nullIfUndefined(API_FilterPersonPaymentView.data?.content?.[0]?.streetFK),
  
    communicationId: nullIfUndefined(v_communication.value?.communicationId)
  }

  await v_payloadOnSave.setValue(payload)

  await API_SaveTitular.run()
  message.success("Date salvate!")
}

generatePayload()

function nullIfUndefined(value) {
  return value === undefined ? null : value
}

async function generatePayload() {
  try {
    await v_isLoadingSave.setValue(true)
    
    if(inputNumeOP.value == "") {
      message.error("Datele reprezentantului temporar sunt obligatorii.")
      return
    }

    if(inputPostCodeRepTempOP.value == "") {
      message.error("Oficiul postal trebuie completat.")
      return
    }

    
    const countryNameFromId = API_GetCountries.data.find(e => e.id == selectTaraRepTempOP.value).name
    const defaultTempRep = await API_FilterTemporaryRepresentativeView.run()
    const defaultTempRepAddress = await API_FilterTemporaryAddressView.run()

     console.log("countryNameFromId: ", countryNameFromId)
     console.log("defaultTempRep: ", defaultTempRep)
     console.log("defaultTempRepAddress: ", defaultTempRepAddress)

    
    const payload = {
      temporaryRepresentativeId: nullIfUndefined(defaultTempRep?.content[0]?.id),
      cns: nullIfUndefined(API_FindPersonByCnpOP.data.content[0].cns),
      countryId: nullIfUndefined(selectTaraRepTempOP.value),
      countryName: nullIfUndefined(countryNameFromId ?? "RO"),
      countyName: nullIfUndefined(inputJudetRepTempOP.value),
      locality: nullIfUndefined(inputLocalitateRepTempOP.value),
      streetName: nullIfUndefined(inputStradaRepTempOP.value),
      streetNumber: nullIfUndefined(inputContainerTitularCorespondentaNr.value),
      building: nullIfUndefined(inputBuildingRepTempOP.value),
      buildingEntrance: nullIfUndefined(inputScaraRepTempOP.value),
      floorNumber: nullIfUndefined(inputEtajRepTempOP.value),
      apartmentNumber: nullIfUndefined(inputApartmentRepTempOP.value),
      justifyingDetails: nullIfUndefined(textAreaDetaliiRepTempOP.value),
      personTypeId: nullIfUndefined(radioPersoanaAbilitata.value),
      authorizationStartDate: nullIfUndefined(dataStartProcura.value),
      authorizationEndDate: nullIfUndefined(dataScadentaProcura.value),
      authorizationNumber: nullIfUndefined(inputNrProcura.value),
      beneficiaryCNS: nullIfUndefined(v_beneficaryCNS.value),
      pensionFileId: nullIfUndefined(v_communication.value?.pensionFileId),
      rightsCollectionId: nullIfUndefined(API_FilterPersonPaymentView.data?.content?.[0]?.rightsCollectionId),
      ownerQualityId: nullIfUndefined(radioCalitateTitular.value),
      agreementDate: nullIfUndefined(dataProcura.value),
      communicationId: nullIfUndefined(v_communication.value?.communicationId),
      postalOfficeId: nullIfUndefined(v_postalCodeIdFromTbLOP.value ?? defaultTempRepAddress?.content[0]?.postalOfficeId),

      // importante
      countyFKRo: nullIfUndefined(T_CountyIdFromInputOP.value),
      localityFK: nullIfUndefined(T_LocalityIdFromInputOP.value),
      streetFK: nullIfUndefined(T_StreetIdFromInputOP.value),
      postalOfficeCode: nullIfUndefined(v_postalCodeIdFromTbLOP.value ?? defaultTempRepAddress?.content[0]?.postalOfficeId),
 
      contactAddressId: nullIfUndefined(defaultTempRepAddress?.content?.[0]?.addressId),      
    }

    console.log("payload: ", payload)
  
    await v_payloadOnSave.setValue(payload)
    console.log("v_payloadOnSave.value: ", v_payloadOnSave.value)
  
    await API_SavePersoanaIndividualaOP.run()
    message.success("Detaliile de plata au fost salvate cu succes!")
      
  } catch {
     await v_isLoadingSave.setValue(false)
     await JS_ErrorSavePayload.run()
  } finally {
     await v_isLoadingSave.setValue(false)
  }
}

generatePayload()
return message.error(API_SavePersoanaIndividualaOP.data.errorMessage)
